notes.title: NEW TRAILER OUT NOW — FACE WHAT LURKS WITHIN
notes.notes:
[p]Today, we’re revealing a brand new trailer for [i]Endless Night: The Darkness Within[/i]—our most personal game yet. This isn’t just a game. It’s a descent into the subconscious... into memory, trauma, and transformation.[/p][p][/p][p]You play as Jake, a man caught between fear and something deeper—something burning quietly inside. Is it power? Madness? A call to heal? You’ll have to find out for yourself.[/p][p]The images in this trailer might be unsettling. They might disturb you. But sometimes the only way out... is through.[/p][p][/p][p][b]No one can tell you what Endless Night is. You have to experience it for yourself.[/b][/p][p][/p][p][b]Watch the new trailer here:[/b]
[dynamiclink href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=6YU8-Jr07B0&ab_channel=littleguygames"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]Thank you for walking this path with us. This is just the beginning.[/p][p][/p][p]—Team Endless Night[/p]
